scope: Clean-room follow-up using NVIDIA-authored interface definitions, the installed driver, public release documentation, and a bounded root-run experiment. No proprietary mVolt code or binaries were used.

tested_configuration.limitation: One tested configuration and operating point; no board or driver compatibility gate follows.

status: Live REL upper-only controls are integrated, with a root-run product apply/restore test. Arbitrary six-word voltage request replay remains unresolved.

new_public_lead.claim: The release describes an experimental voltage-offset BIOS override enabled after a GPU restart.
new_public_lead.limit: The public description does not establish its implementation or a way to clear the independently traced PERF offset-copy suppression flag.

static_findings: The confirmed PERF+0x32C constructor assignment comes from the GPU HAL index. The bounded follow-up found no proven BIOS or registry control for that flag.
The two recognized BIOS rail subtype paths converge on the same gated six-word row setter. Changing subtype alone is not an established bypass.

NVIDIA's NVOC exported-method record stores its function pointer 0x10 bytes before methodId. Equation SET 0x2080E0B7 uses handler 0x4CE4C0; variable SET 0x2080E0B4 uses 0x4CE910 in this inspected image.

Equation SET selects existing rows in the same 8192-entry, 0x80-byte-row geometry returned by the independent CONTROL getter. The traced row path can write bounds before a later error, and the group may repeat its internal update. A successful status is insufficient.
The equation handler's post-call through PERF+0x588 remains unnamed. No physical-voltage or firmware-consumer conclusion is drawn.

experiment.operation: Unchanged selected REL equation row; no bound, coefficient, BIOS or registry change requested

difference.field: Evaluated frequency word in V/F curve entries

timed_get_only_followup.operation: One further unchanged-row SET, preceded by a timed GET-only control and followed by GET-only observation before any restoration decision

post_set.first_difference: The same 78 evaluated frequency words and byte-identical changed curve as the earlier trial; every other retained configured component, equation packet and complete BoostTable remained exact

timed_get_only_followup.limitation: Capture intervals do not identify the exact settling instant. This one timed repeat demonstrates recovery without a second SET on the tested configuration, not a universal delay or the callback's mechanism.

interpretation: The timed no-op repeat returned to the full captured baseline without restoration. A changed live REL upper bound then produced exact independent definition readbacks and the observed REL/ALT policy change throughout a 20-second window, followed by full original-state recovery. The assembled product controller independently passed apply and same-controller restore. This supports the separate live upper-clamp control on the tested configuration; the post-group callback remains unnamed, physical voltage was not measured, and neither arbitrary legacy rail request replay nor mVolt implementation is established.
next_required_evidence: Identify the still-unnamed post-group callback and extend operation-specific evidence for other equation writes without treating this one upper-clamp trial as their qualification.
Find and verify an independently understood voltage-offset enabling mechanism or alternative request path; no BIOS toggle follows from a public feature name.
For changing-offset capability, verify all six actual request words and peers, restoring original requests while the enabling capability remains active before reverting it.

live_upper_bound_trial.operation: One selected type6 REL upper float; all other row and packet bytes preserved

prior_interrupted_trial.reason: The first comparator did not project mirrored equation and policy diagnostic copies; it stopped and restored. Independent raw-byte analysis found only the intended one-word definition projection, graph-affected policy values and computed curve differences.

live_upper_bound_trial.scope: One tested rail, bound and operating point. No physical enforcement, universal policy formula, fixed delay, type3 write or other-rail hardware result is inferred.

product_end_to_end.repeat_edit_binding: The ROM graph, terms and lower bound stay bound; the current loaded upper comes from fresh native readback.
product_end_to_end.failed_write_recovery: One original-row compensation after native entry, bounded GET-only recovery, retained original error and explicit recovery status.
product_end_to_end.unavailable_peers: Absent optional getters remain listed independently; failures from present getters use bounded read-only recovery.
